$comment: Public image sources. License is checked per item at collect time; the entry license is only a default for kinds whose host does not publish one per file. Add entries, never hand-curate items.

sources.notes: 24 classic test images, 768x512 lossless. Smoke source: tiny and stable.
Real scene radiance with real highlight range. The only kind of source that teaches highlight recovery; the floor camera's clipping is physical there.
Second CC0 HDRI library; zip downloads, unpack in the shard step.
Curated high-resolution photographs. License read per file from extmetadata; anything outside CC0/CC BY/CC BY-SA/PD is skipped.
Larger pool, same per-file license check. Expect hundreds of thousands of files; use --max-bytes.
Template for any Hugging Face dataset repo. The tree API publishes the LFS sha256 per file, so every shard is verified. Set repo, confirm the dataset card license, flip enabled.
Template for a Zenodo record. The API publishes md5 per file and the license id in metadata.
